Header.value: Select a class, then drag on the timeline (start -> end). Same-class events that overlap are one segment.

Label.hint: Start: first frame with visible contact. End: all involved stop moving or leave frame
Start: onset of braking/swerving. End: road users clear of each other
Start: vehicle front crosses stop line on red. End: leaves intersection/frame
Start: enters opposing lane. End: back in correct lane or leaves frame
Start: starts turning. End: completes the turn
Stationary on carriageway >= 10 s, not queued at signal. Start: stops. End: moves or removed
Start: pedestrian steps onto road outside a crossing. End: leaves the road
Start: vehicle enters crossing while pedestrian on it. End: vehicle leaves crossing
Start: starts turning. End: completes the turn
Start: wheel crosses the solid line. End: fully in the new lane
Stops past stop line on red, not entering. Start: vehicle stops. End: signal turns green
Standstill/crawl across all lanes of a direction. Start: queue stops moving. End: queue clears
Debris/animal/fallen object. Start: appears. End: removed
Start: first visible smoke. End: smoke clears or video ends
